page_title: RSO 2-0 BET | Real Sociedad v Betis 01/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Betis.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
86' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
83' The attendance is 28119.
83' Substitution. Jesus Rodriguez will be replaced by Juanmi (Betis).
83' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Sergi Altimira will be replaced by Mateo Flores (Betis).
80' A substitution has been made. Brais Mendez is replaced by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad).
79' Chimy Avila (Betis) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Francisco Maeso ignores the protests.
74' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball towards goal and it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
73' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar.
71' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Vitor Roque and he is replaced by Cedric Bakambu (Betis).
71' Substitution. Mikel Oyarzabal walks off the pitch and Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.
66' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Betis out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.

64' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Alex Remiro, who pulls off a comfortable save!
63' Flag up against Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
60' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:1.
55' Here's the change. Abde Ezzalzouli leaves the pitch and Chimy Avila (Betis) comes on as a substitute.
55' A substitution has been made. Carlos Guirao goes off and Iker Losada (Betis) comes on.
55' Here is a change. Benat Turrientes is going off and Imanol Alguacil gives the last tactical orders to Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad).
55' It is time for a substitution. Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) is on for Ander Barrenetxea.
54' Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
53' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
51' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) heads on.
47' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francisco Maeso had an easy-decision to make.
46' Imanol Alguacil has made a change at the break. Jon Pacheco has come on in place of Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
45+2' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) attempts to discuss the decision with Francisco Maeso, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
45+2' The referee gives a yellow card to Marc Bartra (Betis) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
41' Real Sociedad are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
37' Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
34' The game is interrupted now, Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
31' 2 - 0 GOAL! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) strikes the penalty low down the middle and scores after the ball glances off the leg of Rui Silva.
30' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is going to take the penalty!
30' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
29' Referee Francisco Maeso has finally had enough of Manuel Pellegrini and brandishes a yellow card at him!

28' There's a break in play and referee Francisco Maeso must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Real Sociedad using VAR. This could be interesting!
27' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Real Sociedad for a penalty. Play continues.
26' Sergi Altimira (Betis) connects with a loose ball in the box, but sends his first-time shot miles over the bar.
26' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
25' Vitor Roque (Betis) takes the corner.
24' Vitor Roque (Betis) is about to take a corner kick.
23' Betis can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
20' Vitor Roque (Betis) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
16' Rough tackle by Carlos Guirao (Betis). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
14' 1 - 0 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Diego Llorente (Betis), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 1:0.
12' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) sends an accurate short pass. Carlos Guirao controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
6' The ball is cleared after Vitor Roque (Betis) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
4' Real Sociedad control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The first half has just begun.
Real Sociedad will kick-off.
Francisco Maeso got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
